Name: Lots of Kisses
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Lots of Kisses![/size][size=4] 💕[/size][/color][/b]

Bring a little more affection, playfulness, and romance to your relationships.

[b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] expands the ways you can interact with your spouse or romantic partner by adding sweet, spontaneous kisses, longer affectionate moments, and funny reactions from the people around you.

Give your partner a [b][color=#c27ba0]quick kiss[/color][/b] or stay close together for a sequence of [color=#c27ba0][b]multiple kisses[/b][/color]. If you get a little carried away in public, nearby villagers may notice, comment, or react to your romantic display—and your partner may have something to say about it too!
[heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Main Features[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Bump Kiss[/color][/b] — gently bump into your partner to give them a quick kiss.[/*]
[*][color=#c27ba0][b]Multi-Kiss[/b] [/color]— stay close together and enjoy a longer sequence of kisses.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Bystander Reactions[/color][/b] — nearby NPCs may notice and react when they see you kissing.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Partner Reactions[/color][/b] — your partner may become embarrassed and comment during romantic moments in public.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Spouses and Dating Partners[/color][/b] — enjoy affectionate interactions both before and after marriage.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Polyamory Compatible[/color][/b] — supports multiple romantic partners when used with polyamory mods.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Custom NPC Support[/color][/b] — romanceable NPCs added by other mods can also participate.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Custom Dialogue Packs[/color][/b] — additional dialogue can be added for different characters and languages.[/*]
[/list]NPCs without custom dialogue are still supported, so you can kiss them normally even if no character-specific dialogue pack is available.

[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b][color=#c27ba0]SMAPI[/color][/b].[/*]
[*]Download and extract [b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI and have fun![/*]
[/list][heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Opcional[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#c27ba0][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [/color]— easily customize the mod’s settings from inside the game.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Tile Marker[/color][/b] — a tool that lets you mark counters, tables, chairs, decorations, or other objects that clearly shouldn’t prevent an NPC from seeing you. This is useful when a character should be able to see your kiss but doesn’t react because the game treats nearby furniture as an obstacle. This tool only changes how [b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] checks visibility—it does not modify maps, furniture, or collisions.[/*]
[/list][color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Compatibility [/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10062]Hugs and Kisses[/url] . Both mods can be installed and used together.
[b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses 1.0.4[/color][/b] also includes built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] . Recruited spouses and romantic partners can still receive Bump Kisses and Multi-Kisses while following you.
The [b][color=#c27ba0]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/b] also includes an option that lets you choose whether kisses may temporarily interrupt a partner who is performing a Stardew Squad task. After the kiss ends, they will be released and can continue what they were doing. If this option is disabled, working partners won’t be interrupted, but idle or following partners can still be kissed normally. 💕

[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Player-to-Player Marriage — Experimental[/b][/size][/color]

The mod now includes experimental support for multiplayer couples where one farmer is married to another farmer. It works in both split-screen and online co-op, with support for Bump Kisses, automatic Multi-Kisses, and the mod’s manual kiss options.
For the best results, both players should have the same version of Lots of Kisses installed. Players can also choose whether they want to accept kisses from their farmer spouse through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Since this feature is still experimental, small visual or synchronization issues may occasionally happen depending on the platform or connection. If you encounter a problem, please send me your full SMAPI log and explain whether you were playing online or in split-screen so I can investigate it. 

Now go give your favorite person a kiss… or ten. 💖
